description: Test script for verifying IP address consistency between cellular manager logs and wwan0 interface on a device, including module loading, device reboot, log parsing, and IP comparison.

classes.name: TDKScriptingLibrary
classes.description: Library providing test scripting functionalities for module loading, test step creation, and execution.

methods.name: configureTestCase
methods.description: Configures the test case with IP, port, and test name.

methods.name: getLoadModuleResult
methods.description: Retrieves the result of loading a module.

methods.name: setLoadModuleStatus
methods.description: Sets the status after attempting to load a module.

methods.name: createTestStep
methods.description: Creates a test step object for executing specific test commands.

methods.name: executeTestCase
methods.description: Executes the test step and returns success or failure.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Retrieves the result of the executed test step.

methods.name: getResultDetails
methods.description: Retrieves detailed output from the test step.
